note: RHB Mastercard offers. Tiles are div.col cards in the home and profile tab panes; each has an h5.card-title merchant name and a Learn more link. Only tiles whose link is an on-domain terms PDF under mastercard-offers/pdf/ (the folder is Microsites or microsites) are offers, and the item selector keeps only those; the key is the tile name (h5.card-title), which is unique on the page, and the dates and eligibility are read from the PDF. The links are page-relative (-/media/...), so they resolve under /cards/mastercard-offers/; on 2026-11-20 that path served the same file as the root /-/media/... path (checked for tnc-bens.pdf). Four GL Play tiles share tnc-mc-glplay.pdf, so the PDF alone does not identify a tile. Profile tab tiles that link to specials.priceless.com and every contact tab tile (mtr.mastercardservices.com) are Mastercard network offers on off-config hosts; they are not fetched and not handed in.
